label: Click stream (cursor through web content, event chips)
description: A hand working through the internet -- a relay piece (the Quotient Analytics film). Web content RUSHES past (a strip of pieces sliding sideways while the camera pulls back and pushes in; the strip bunches as it pulls back, so the rush is dense; nothing fades or blurs) and STOPS on a piece, centred in `region` at a readable size (k = min(fit_w x region width / w, fit_h x region height / h): landing pages ~90% of the width, tall pieces ~85% of the height) on clean canvas with a soft shadow. The built-in cursor glides to the stop's `target` (image pixels [x,y,w,h]) and clicks it (0.12 s press + ring; the target flashes a purple press ring), and the click throws a purple EVENT CHIP (white Geist 600, a pill with a dot) that springs out of the click point, flies an arc and lands -- centred, shrunk to chip_land_scale -- EXACTLY at `chip_to` at its land time, then vanishes (the film's activity feed takes over there as a new row). Five to seven stops, each faster than the last. SCHEDULE (scene seconds, published on the root as data-click-times / data-land-times / data-arrive-times / data-leave-times, ms precision): with N stops, hold_i = first_hold x (last_hold/first_hold)^(i/(N-1)); travel_i (the rush INTO stop i, i>=1) = travel x (last_travel/travel)^((i-1)/(N-2)) (N=2: travel); arrive_0 = at + enter; arrive_i = leave_{i-1} + travel_i; click_i = arrive_i + click_at x hold_i; leave_i = arrive_i + hold_i; land_i = click_i + chip_pop + chip_travel. Defaults (6 stops, at 0): clicks 1.05, 2.41, 3.58, 4.58, 5.44, 6.19; lands +0.6. `times` [...] overrides the click moments (each stop then sits round its click with the formula's hold; land = time + chip_pop + chip_travel); `grid` quantizes computed clicks to a music grid. END: end_mode "hold" keeps the last stop where it landed; "zoom" grows it at zoom_at (default leave of the last stop) over zoom_duration (0.5 s, power3.inOut) to COVER the region (k = max(region w / w, region h / h), object-fit cover) with the target pulled as close to the region centre as the cover allows (zoom_focus "target"; "center" centres the image), then FROZEN to the scene end with the cursor resting on the target; "smash" (strip layout) zings every piece -- the ones off screen too, from their own side -- into the region centre one after another from smash_at (default leave of the last stop) over smash_duration (0.8 s), accelerating and spinning down to nothing; a ring flashes and a dot stays there, published as the anchor `core` (data-smash-time = start,end): the next piece is born from it with enter {effect: "morph", from: "<this id>.core"}. data-last-target="cx,cy,w,h" is the last target's box after it settles, in fractions of the component box: hold: left = RX + RW/2 - w k/2, top = RY + RH/2 - h k/2 with k = min(fit_w RW/w, fit_h RH/h); zoom: k = max(RW/w, RH/h), left = RX + clamp(RW/2 - (tx + tw/2) k, RW - w k, 0), top = RY + clamp(RH/2 - (ty + th/2) k, RH - h k, 0); then cx = (left + (tx + tw/2) k)/W, cy = (top + (ty + th/2) k)/H, w = tw k/W, h = th k/H (RX..RH = region in box px, W x H = the component box; a full-frame slot is the camera layer, 40 px larger than the frame, so fractions are of that box, as with every other piece). data-settle-time is when it stops moving. Example: {"region":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":0.62,"h":1},"at":0.25,"chip_to":[0.8,0.3],"stream":[{"src":"/assets/c03.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350},{"src":"/assets/c07.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350}],"stops":[{"src":"/assets/c01.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350,"target":[64,1144,364,90],"chip":"Clicked · Try Flows free — Kestrel","kind":"email"},{"src":"/assets/northwind-full.png","w":1920,"h":1080,"target":[552,812,360,92],"chip":"Clicked · See the report — Northwind","kind":"email"}],"end_mode":"zoom"}. LAYOUT "float" (the customer journey: the cursor floats through a space of web content and finds a landing page, click; an email, click; a social post, click; an ad, click): the stops AND the stream live in a 3D field inside `region`, scattered wider than the region at varied depth with slight tilts and a slow seeded bob, far pieces in a light haze of the canvas colour (`fog`). Stops lie on a meander (each further right, alternately up and down); the stream is background depth (smaller, slower parallax). The CAMERA travels stop to stop (translate + a gentle breath out, float_zoom, mid-travel); as it settles, the stop comes forward to the SAME fit box as the strip (centred in the region, k = min(fit_w RW/w, fit_h RH/h)), flat (no tilt, no bob) so its target is exact; click; chip; at leave it recedes into depth as the next one comes forward. The cursor is the traveller: between click_{i-1} + 0.14 and click_i - 0.08 it floats on a cubic arc (an arch over or under the chord, alternating, cursor_arc high) and settles onto the next target before the click. The schedule is the SAME formula (and `times` / `grid`) -- arrive = the stop is flat in its fit box, leave = it starts to recede. Float reads calmer with longer travels (e.g. travel 0.6, last_travel 0.4). FIRST FRAME at `at`: start "drift" (default) -- the field is at opacity 0 (an empty region; the cursor at cursor_from) and fades in over min(0.45, 0.8 (arrive_0 - at)) while the camera drifts in from a pulled-back pose to stop 0; start "burst" -- every piece sits at `burst_from` [x, y] (box fractions, default the region centre) at scale 0 (an empty region; the cursor starts on that point unless cursor_from says otherwise) and flies out to its place, all home by arrive_0 (for a join from a word or a dot). end_mode hold / zoom behave exactly as in the strip, and data-last-target uses the same formula. WHERE EACH TARGET SITS AT ITS CLICK (both layouts; for hand-offs): data-click-points="cx,cy;cx,cy;..." (box fractions), = RX + RW/2 - w k/2 + (tx + tw/2) k, RY + RH/2 - h k/2 + (ty + th/2) k, over W and H (the last stop under zoom: its box at that moment). data-layout names the layout. CAPTIONS (either layout): stops[i].caption (e.g. "Landing page", "Email", "Social post", "Ad", "Blog") is a Geist 600 label on a soft white pill with a chip-coloured dot, above the stop's top-left corner (straddling that edge when a tall stop leaves no room above), in from arrive - 0.14 (0.3 s), out from leave - 0.06 (0.18 s); the last stop's stays (hold) or leaves as the zoom starts. DROPS (either layout): cursorless SYSTEM events from outside marketing, drops: [{icon: a logo src, label: "Meeting booked · Calendly", at, from?: [x, y] box fractions}] -- a white rounded tile (logo left, label) springs in at `from` (default a seeded point on the region's right side, in the band away from the target clicked nearest in time), holds drop_hold (0.35 s), then flies the chip's arc to chip_to with the chip's landing scale, landing CENTRED on chip_to at at + chip_pop + drop_hold + chip_travel (published as data-drop-land-times), gone after (+ chip_hold). Float example: {"layout":"float","region":{"x":0,"y":0,"w":0.6175,"h":1},"chip_to":[0.7755,0.2433],"at":0.25,"travel":0.6,"last_travel":0.4,"stream":[{"src":"/assets/c03.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350}],"stops":[{"src":"/assets/l01.jpg","w":1600,"h":1000,"target":[613,675,373,60],"chip":"Visited · Pricing — Northwind","caption":"Landing page"},{"src":"/assets/c02.jpg","w":1080,"h":1350,"target":[72,1132,304,90],"chip":"Registered · Webinar — Tidewell","caption":"Email"}],"end_mode":"zoom"}. Burst start: {"layout":"float","start":"burst","burst_from":[0.31,0.5], ...}. Drops: {"drops":[{"icon":"/assets/logo-calendly.png","label":"Meeting booked · Calendly","at":3.1},{"icon":"/assets/logo-salesforce.png","label":"Opportunity created · Salesforce","at":5.6,"from":[0.45,0.2]}]}.

stops.label: The pieces it stops on, in order (1-12; 5-7 reads best): {src, w, h (image pixels), target: [x, y, w, h] (PIXELS of that image: the thing clicked), chip: event text (e.g. "Clicked · Pricing — Northwind"), kind?: email|landing|social|ad|blog (names the default chip verb), caption?: a label at the stop's top-left while it holds (e.g. "Landing page", "Email", "Social post", "Ad", "Blog")}

layout.label: strip (default: pieces rush past on one sliding line) | float (a 3D field of content; the camera travels stop to stop, the cursor floats between them on arcs -- the customer journey)

start.label: float: drift (default: the field fades in from opacity 0 at `at` while the camera drifts to stop 0) | burst (every piece flies out of burst_from, scale 0 at `at`)

burst_from.label: float, start burst: the point the pieces fly out of [x, y] (box fractions; default the region centre); the cursor starts there too unless cursor_from is given

float_zoom.label: float: the camera's zoom mid-travel (a gentle breath out, default 0.84; 1 = none)

rest_scale.label: float: a stop's size in the field vs its fit box (default 0.44)

density.label: float: how many stream pieces fill the field (default 1; 0 = stops only; up to 3)

bob.label: float: how much the field drifts and sways (default 1; 0 = still)

fog.label: float: the haze colour far pieces sink into (default `background`, else #efeeea, the film's canvas) -- set it to the scene's canvas colour

cursor_arc.label: float: how high the cursor's arc bows between targets, fraction of the region height (default 0.2)

caption_size.label: Caption font size, fraction of the box width (default 0.0102)

drops.label: Cursorless system events from outside marketing, either layout: {icon: logo src, label: "Meeting booked · Calendly", at: s, from?: [x, y] box fractions}. Each pops in, holds drop_hold, flies to chip_to and lands at at + chip_pop + drop_hold + chip_travel (data-drop-land-times)

drop_hold.label: Seconds a drop sits where it popped in before flying (default 0.35)

stream.label: Background pieces that rush past between stops, {src, w, h}; reused in order (give 12-30)

region.label: Where the stream plays inside the box, fractions {x, y, w, h} (default the whole box; the film uses {x:0,y:0,w:0.62,h:1} with the feed on the right). Pieces are clipped to it; chips and the cursor are not

at.label: When the strip starts sliding in from the region's right edge (float: when the field starts to fade or burst in) (s, default 0)

enter.label: Seconds from `at` until the first stop has landed (default 0.5)

first_hold.label: How long the first stop sits (s, default 1.1)

last_hold.label: How long the last stop sits before the end/zoom (s, default 0.45); holds between are geometric

travel.label: The rush into the second stop (s, default 0.35)

last_travel.label: The rush into the last stop (s, default 0.25); geometric between

click_at.label: Where in each hold the click lands, 0-1 (default 0.5)

times.label: Explicit click moments (s), one per stop -- overrides the formula

grid.label: Quantize computed click moments to this grid (s, e.g. 0.25); omit for the exact formula

chip_to.label: Where every chip lands (its centre), fractions of the box [x, y] (default [0.8, 0.3])

chip_pop.label: Seconds the chip springs out of the click point (default 0.15)

chip_travel.label: Seconds the chip flies to chip_to (default 0.45)

chip_hold.label: Seconds the chip stays at chip_to after landing (default 0: gone as it lands)

chip_size.label: Chip font size, fraction of the box width (default 0.0105)

chip_arc.label: How high the chip's flight arcs, fraction of the box height (default 0.12)

chip_land_scale.label: The chip's scale as it lands (default 0.88)

end_mode.label: After the last stop: hold (it stays) | zoom (it grows to cover the region, then freezes) | smash (every piece zings into the region's centre, a ring flashes and a dot stays -- the anchor `core` the next piece morphs out of)

smash_at.label: smash: when the pieces start zinging in (default: the last stop's leave time)

smash_duration.label: smash: seconds from the first piece leaving to the dot (default 0.8)

core_size.label: smash: the dot left behind, a fraction of the box's shorter side (default 0.05)

zoom_at.label: zoom: when the last stop starts growing (default: its leave time)

zoom_focus.label: zoom: target (pull the target toward the region centre, default) | center

fit_w.label: A stop's resting width cap, fraction of the region width (default 0.9)

fit_h.label: A stop's resting height cap, fraction of the region height (default 0.85)

rush_scale.label: How far the camera pulls back mid-rush (scale, default 0.5)

background.label: Region fill (default none: the scene's canvas, #efeeea in the film)

clip.label: Clip the pieces to the region (default true)

seed.label: Changes the stream pieces' sizes, tilts and offsets (same seed, same stream)

cursor_from.label: Where the cursor starts at `at` [x, y] (fractions of the box; default low right of the region) -- the previous piece's cursor_to

cursor_to.label: Where the cursor goes after the last click [x, y] (omit: it rests on the last target, riding the zoom)

cursor_to_at.label: When it leaves for cursor_to (default: the zoom end, or last click + 0.3)

cursor_exit_at.label: When the cursor vanishes (omit to keep it)

cursor_size.label: Cursor size, a fraction of the box width (default 0.027)
